vb_textbox.text: Make sure you concentrate and stay focussed as you won't have much time to think before getting timed out. I found I concentrated on the gnomes with the bigger hats, if one had smaller and one had larger. I found the big purple and big pink hatted gnomes were quite good ones to choose, and also the big brown one, occasionally the big blue one and the small green one. The small red and yellow were quite hit and miss. I did not really find a strategy, it was very much based on luck a lot of the time, I just continued to choose gnomes that had brought me luck previously. You will probably find that they will return 0 mushrooms on some occasions, but they then go on to find more as the game goes on.
